text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #7448d1

g.text: Wait until policy, required inputs and earlier jobs all permit starting.
The latest of these times is R. Actual execution starts at S, possibly later.
The wait is S minus R; the finish is S plus the work duration.
r_pol: policy start; A: input-ready time; pred: required earlier job/stage pairs.
S/F: actual start/finish; C: execution duration; Q: wait. i and u index prior jobs/stages.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #7448d1

g.text: The required topic/flow is available at 4,300 ms.
The earlier lyric-writing step finishes at 4,500 ms.
Busy renderer starts this bar at S = 5,000 ms.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #7448d1

g.text: These equations separate execution time from waiting.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #7448d1

g.text: An edit may delay input readiness before a request can run. Shared resources may add waiting afterward.
A faster speech model reduces C, but does not by itself remove either kind of delay.
